# Trump's approval hits 'new low.' See latest U.S., NC approval ratings

Portrait of Iris Seaton

As August 2026 begins, another round of approval polls for President Donald Trump is available.
results.title: Trump's approval hits 'new low.' See latest U.S., NC approval ratings

results.content:
